en.headline: Chan says IPO haul tops HK$388 billion in nine months
en.dek: The financial secretary also said Golden Week's first three days brought more than 732,000 mainland visitor arrivals, up about 8.4%.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said in his Sunday blog that companies listing in Hong Kong raised more than HK$388 billion in the first nine months of 2026. He said the amount was more than double the same period a year earlier and had already surpassed the total for the whole of 2025. He put the number of listings at 116.

Chan also said average daily turnover on the Hong Kong stock market from January to September was HK$272.9 billion, up 6.4% from a year earlier. He said long-term US bond yields had risen to a 24-year high, which had increased concern about the global outlook and dampened recent sentiment in the local market.

On tourism, Chan said more than 732,000 mainland visitor arrivals were recorded in the first three days of the National Day Golden Week, about 8.4% more than a year earlier. He said arrivals from Europe, the United States and some emerging markets had also grown this year. Ming Pao reported that the Immigration Department expected about 1.29 million mainland visitors over the whole Golden Week, with the daily average up more than 5% year on year.

Chan wrote that he had visited Doha last week for the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank annual meeting, and said cooperation between Hong Kong, the Middle East and the Global South was moving from capital and people flows toward project work and sharing of institutional experience. He said Middle East participation in Hong Kong listings had increased over the past year.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：首九個月新股集資逾3880億元
zh.dek: 財政司長在網誌指，集資額按年多一倍並超越去年全年；黃金周首三日內地旅客逾73.2萬人次，按年增約8.4%。
body: 財政司長陳茂波星期日在網誌表示，今年首九個月共有116家企業在港上市，集資額逾3880億元，按年上升超過一倍，並已超越去年全年總額。
陳茂波說，首九個月港股平均每日成交額2729億元，較去年同期增長6.4%。他又指，美國長期債息升至24年高位，投資者對環球經濟前景的顧慮增加，近期港股氣氛亦受影響。
旅遊方面，陳茂波說，國慶黃金周首三天有逾73.2萬人次內地旅客訪港，按年增加約8.4%。他又指，今年以來來自歐美及部分新興市場的旅客人數錄得增長。明報引述入境處預計，整個黃金周約有129萬內地旅客訪港，日均人次按年上升超過5%。
陳茂波寫道，他上星期到卡塔爾多哈出席亞洲基礎設施投資銀行年會，認為國家和香港與中東以至全球南方的合作，正由資金和人員流動，走向更具體的項目合作及制度經驗分享。他說，過去一年中東資金參與本港新股上市的程度明顯增加。
